verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a Muted item status that silences known-noisy items, and its grouping, custom fingerprinting and item merging collapse repeated occurrences into single items, which cuts duplicate alerts. Notifications are configured through a project-level menu with PagerDuty and Slack integrations, but nothing describes how that routing suppresses floods. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-key or per-token rate limits, configurable ignore/filter rules beyond muting, documented alert throttling or deduplication for PagerDuty, and any hands-on corroboration that these controls prevent overnight paging.
